theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_wrm_cutoff_mass_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (y : Euclidean N) (h : Euclidean N → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A R t₀ : ℝ), Continuous h → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 0 < A → (∀ s, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → μ (closedBall y R) ≠ ∞ → 0 < t₀ → t₀ * A < R → HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ ∫ z, φ (‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) * h z ∂μ) (∫ z, deriv φ (‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t₀ ^ 2) * (-2 * ‖z - y‖ ^ 2 / t₀ ^ 3) * h z ∂μ) t₀
